title: H8 fix round 3: the shared indexed event filtering regresses test_all_reviews_failed_holds_without_merge (daemon gets failed instead of held); restore the daemon's review-failure read path while keeping the cursor-safe filters (gate_red on T-0379)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain f43c354 (T-0360), 0751d53 (T-0374) and a25898a (T-0379) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Gate red on T-0379, reproduced on a clean external run: exactly one failure, tests/test_daemon.py::Daemon::test_all_reviews_failed_holds_without_merge, AssertionError: 'failed' != 'held'. That test was green at T-0360's gate, so the regression comes from the T-0374/T-0379 changes to bus.events and its shared task-index filtering (bus.py, bus_mcp.py). Diagnose first: run python -m unittest tests.test_daemon -k all_reviews_failed in the worktree, read how the daemon decides that every review of a task failed (bus.read or bus.events calls in daemon.merge_reviewed or its helpers) and what changed in what bus.events now returns (row shape, filtering by the task index, or events for tasks missing from the index being dropped). Fix in bus.py so callers that pass no filters get exactly the previous rows and shape, and events whose task is absent from the index are never dropped by a role filter unless a role was requested; keep the T-0374 and T-0379 semantics (single fetch, next_since from the unfiltered page, filtered rows never above next_since). Do not modify tests/test_daemon.py's assertion. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0 (whole suite), then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows a25898a, 0751d53 and f43c354 below your commit
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
